_doc: P3.PAYMENTS.1 — proposed plan catalog for paid promotion + subscription. SCAFFOLD ONLY. No live processor integration, no live keys, no checkout wiring. Schema lives here as the canonical reference for the future BE phase. Doctrine: no bilingual/mixed-language in any plan copy.

_processors.merchant_of_record: Paris Comedy SAS (legal entity placeholder — to be confirmed)

plans.description_en: One-time payment, lifetime listing highlight + priority slot. First 100 sign-ups only.
plans.description_fr: Paiement unique, mise en avant à vie + créneau prioritaire. Réservé aux 100 premiers inscrits.

plans.description_en: Monthly highlight + priority slot. Available after the first 100 lifetime spots are taken.
plans.description_fr: Mise en avant mensuelle + créneau prioritaire. Disponible une fois les 100 places à vie épuisées.

plans.description_en: Booker promotion: enhanced listing + lineup write access. Introductory rate €1/month for the first 6 months, then €5/month.
plans.description_fr: Promotion booker : annonce enrichie + accès écriture aux line-ups. Tarif d'introduction 1 €/mois les 6 premiers mois, puis 5 €/mois.

plans.description_en: Unlimited outbound direct messages + read receipts. Pairs with the P3.MESSAGING.1 scaffold.
plans.description_fr: Messages directs sortants illimités + accusés de lecture. Lié au scaffold P3.MESSAGING.1.

plans.name_fr: Mise en avant du show (7 jours)
plans.description_en: Featured slot on the shows page for 7 days.
plans.description_fr: Créneau mis en avant sur la page des shows pendant 7 jours.

doctrine.vat_handling: FR 20% VAT inclusive in displayed price; invoice line must break out HT / TVA / TTC
